prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1064; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in recently in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I'm the passenger in the car that was hit.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were sitting and what happened?

A: I was in the front passenger seat. We were stopped at a light and then the other car came into our lane. It was a head-on hit, but it didn't feel that hard. The driver was going slowly, I think, maybe just a few miles an hour when they reached us.

Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle?

A: My arm went into the dashboard and then I grabbed the door handle. I felt a sharp pain in my wrist right away.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that same afternoon. They took X-rays and said my wrist was fractured. They put a splint on it and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Have you been able to work since the collision?

A: Not fully. I'm right-handed, so typing and lifting have been hard. I've missed a few shifts.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries to that wrist?

A: No, nothing I can recall.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm still in a lot of pain and I'm waiting to hear about surgery.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
